summary:
The latest campus crime data for Boise State University reflects a variety of incidents reported primarily between late September and early October 2025. A notable increase in vandalism incidents, particularly graffiti at Friendship Bridge, has been recorded, with the case currently open. Additionally, there were multiple reports of hit-and-run accidents, including two incidents at 770 Main and Brady Garage, which remain under investigation.

Domestic violence incidents have also emerged, with one case resulting in an arrest. Alcohol-related violations are prevalent, especially around Jade Hall and the Square – Garnet, where several cases were resolved through referrals to the Dean of Students. Drug law violations and weapons law violations were reported as well, with appropriate actions taken in response.

Overall, while some incidents have been resolved, the data indicates ongoing concerns regarding vandalism, alcohol violations, and traffic-related offenses. The campus community is encouraged to remain vigilant and report any suspicious activities.
